findings.title: Windows File Sharing (SMB) Exposed
findings.description: SMB/NetBIOS (Port 445) is listening on all network interfaces.
findings.recommendation: Ensure SMBv1 is disabled and avoid exposing SMB directly to untrusted networks.

findings.title: Weak Minimum Password Length
findings.description: The minimum password length is set to 0 characters.
findings.recommendation: Increase the minimum password length to at least 8 (or 14+ for strict environments) to prevent brute-force attacks.

findings.title: ML Engine Unavailable

findings.title: Weak LAN Manager Auth Level
findings.description: LMCompatibilityLevel is set to None. NTLMv2 is not strictly enforced.
findings.recommendation: Set LMCompatibilityLevel to 5 to send NTLMv2 responses only and refuse LM & NTLM.

findings.title: SMB Signing Not Enforced
